description: This file contains inline functions for packing weight matrices and biases for quantized neural network operations, specifically for QNNPACK in PyTorch. It includes functions for packing weights for GEMM, convolution, deconvolution, and dilation operations, with support for dynamic and runtime quantization modes, and handles zero points and zero point padding.
